title: COLORA: Efficient Fine-Tuning for Convolutional Models with a Study Case on Optical Coherence Tomography Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2505.18315v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce \textbf{CoLoRA} (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for convolutional neural networks (CNNs). CoLoRA extends LoRA to convolutional layers by decomposing kernel updates into lightweight depthwise and pointwise components. This design reduces the number of trainable convolutional-update parameters by over 80\% compared with full convolutional fine-tuning, while allowing the learned updates to be merged into the pretrained convolutional kernels, thereby preserving the original model size and inference complexity. Experiments on MedMNIST datasets, particularly OCTMNISTv2, demonstrate that CoLoRA applied to VGG16 and ResNet50 achieves competitive classification performance while substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters. translated_title: COLORA：卷积模型的高效微调及其在光学相干断层扫描图像分类中的研究案例
translated_abstract: 我们引入了\textbf{CoLoRA}（卷积低秩适配），一种针对卷积神经网络（CNNs）的参数高效微调方法。CoLoRA将LoRA扩展到卷积层，通过将卷积核更新分解为轻量级的深度卷积和逐点卷积组件。这种设计相比全卷积微调，可训练卷积更新参数减少了超过80%，同时允许学习到的更新合并到预训练的卷积核中，从而保持原始模型大小和推理复杂度不变。在MedMNIST数据集（特别是OCTMNISTv2）上的实验表明，将CoLoRA应用于VGG16和ResNet50，在显著减少可训练参数的同时，取得了具有竞争力的分类性能。与迁移学习、适配器、BitFit和卷积LoRA变体的比较进一步表征了预测性能之间的权衡。
tldr: CoLoRA通过将卷积核更新分解为轻量级深度和逐点组件，实现卷积模型的高效微调，大幅减少可训练参数并保持推理复杂度，在OCT图像分类中表现出竞争力。
en_tdlr: CoLoRA enables efficient fine-tuning of convolutional models by decomposing kernel updates into lightweight depthwise and pointwise components, significantly reducing trainable parameters while maintaining inference complexity, and achieves competitive performance in OCT image classification.
